reviews.text: Year Subscription and Diamonds. So I really liked this at first, to the point I purchased the subscription for the year. BUT don’t. The chats are great, I really enjoyed that, however even with the year subscription there’s still stuff locked that you have to pay for an additional subscription for. AND every single chat cost diamonds! That’s ridiculous, whether you do an action or just talk. And you don’t even realize you’re using your diamonds because there isn’t an icon on the chat area to show them subtracting from your total. I don’t usually do reviews, but I canceled the subscription immediately so it wouldn’t resubmit and am now stuck with an app you can’t use without dumping more money into it, sorry but if someone does the subscriptions, especially the highest ones they should access all options. And really? Do something to fix the diamond requirements for every interaction, you’re going to make people not want to use your app. I will be deleting it unless something changes once the subscription I stupidly paid for runs out.

Ok-ish app.. It’s just ashamed it’s locked up behind a pay wall.

Gems feels absolutely dumb, it feels like anything you do uses gems quickly. Texting, receiving, or even closing the app and having the ai message you randomly which uses gems. It should had been atleast 10 gems for texting so it would atleast last longer.

But I also feel like nothing catches the viewer attention expected the ai, which feels so dang good. But with the horrible/pointless membership and the gems being quite useless as well. I just don’t see myself coming back. Now Im wasting a year of membership on something I won’t be using until I buy more gems.

I really wanna give this review a 3-4 mostly on the ai. But for the app overall it’s gotta be a 1-2 at most. Kinda wish I could get a refund for my year membership cause it’s mostly just being wasted on doing nothing but collecting dust.
